content: 宏福苑 newly appointed manager Hap On recently convened a long-overdue owners' meeting, with chaotic entry arrangements, and deleted agenda items that residents were concerned about, such as re-entering units and disclosing inspection reports. Residents were also dissatisfied that Hap On still asked owners to vote on an erroneous auditor's report, and some criticised Hap On for delaying the release of inspection reports for the remaining seven blocks of Wang Fuk Court. Reporters compiled the key points of the meeting and residents' grievances, and followed up on the progress of the government's acquisition of property rights; former Legislative Council member Sin Chung-kai said the government's means of acquiring property rights gave the impression of adding insult to injury for the disaster victims. On the seventh anniversary of the 7/21 incident, some citizens returned to the scene of that day's attack, with a large number of plain-clothes police officers on guard and stopping passersby for checks. Reporters consolidated the situation inside and outside Yuen Long West Rail Station that evening, and compiled the numbers of people arrested and prosecuted in connection with the 7/21 incident over the past seven years. There are new developments in the case of the independent bookshop being raided;集誌社 (Kai Zhi She) followed up on the matter that a logistics company's Taiwan branch refused to provide services to a Hong Kong independent bookshop that had been investigated by national security authorities, claiming to comply with the National Security Law and refusing to transport 'books that violate regulations' to Hong Kong. When reporters, posing as customers, asked how to determine what constitutes illegal books, a staff member of the Taiwan company explained that books previously involved in national security investigations and removed from book fairs were included in the blacklist. Reporters interviewed scholar To Yiu-ming to analyse the impact of the incident on Hong Kong people's access to outside information.
